ideas.idea: Decide whether to unblock the AI search crawlers (item 1)
ideas.why: This is already a known problem, but the report's framing is accurate; however it duplicates the known robots.txt issue.

ideas.idea: Repair the two broken structured data blocks (item 2)
ideas.why: This duplicates the known FAQ and Article JSON-LD problems.

ideas.idea: Give each page its own canonical address using Astro.url.pathname and a site setting (item 3)
ideas.why: This duplicates the known hardcoded canonical problem.

ideas.idea: Remove /contact from the sitemap or drop the noindex
ideas.why: This duplicates the known sitemap/noindex problem.

ideas.idea: Change the max-snippet:0 fallback to "index, follow"
ideas.why: This duplicates the known max-snippet problem.

ideas.idea: Add LocalBusiness/Organization JSON-LD on the contact page
ideas.why: The page is noindex, so the markup would have little effect, as the report itself notes.

ideas.idea: Flesh out the moorings page with the sizes and seasonal prices its description promises
ideas.why: The page body is one line while its description promises sizes and seasonal prices, so the content is thin and mismatched.

ideas.idea: Show the FAQ Q&As as visible text on the home page
ideas.why: index.astro emits the FAQ only as JSON-LD, so the answers aren't visible to users or crawlers reading the page text.

ideas.idea: Mark up the price with Offer/Product structured data
ideas.why: A single 'from £40' line gives little to mark up, and Product/Offer doesn't clearly fit a mooring page.

ideas.idea: Link 'moorings' in the home page body to /moorings
ideas.why: The home page body has no in-content link to the moorings page, only the nav, so a contextual link is a concrete improvement.

ideas.idea: Add charset, viewport and Open Graph tags, and a <main> element
ideas.why: These are standard head and markup basics that apply to nearly any site.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod dates to the sitemap
ideas.why: This is a standard sitemap tweak with small effect on a three-URL site.

ideas.idea: Set `site` in an Astro config so Astro can generate the sitemap and canonicals
ideas.why: There is no astro.config, the sitemap is hand-kept and URLs are hardcoded, so setting `site` fits this repo.

ideas.idea: Name the harbour (Falmouth) in the home page title, since the H1 says Falmouth
ideas.why: The title says 'Harbor moorings in Cornwall' while the H1 says Falmouth, so naming the town is accurate and specific.
